notes: כֻּלָּהּ is split: כֹּל takes 'wholly' and the suffix takes the recast subject 'she'. The competing reading gives the whole of 'she is wholly' to one token, but each morpheme has an English word of its own here.
הִיא takes only 'this' and the copula joins the predicate noun עִיר, per rule 20's treatment of an explicit subject pronoun.
